# Irenaeus, Against Heresies — source scope

LIB-026 is bound to the retained CCEL ANF1 ThML member at `raw/ccel/anf/anf01.xml` (4,511,814 bytes; SHA-256 `8012ea0e35b497d2fbd783f9d4fd7b3a27d98c6dc66fd427b50d7312e6dd45af`). The existing `config.json` is authoritative for extraction scope: parent `div1` ix and book divisions `ix.ii`, `ix.iii`, `ix.iv`, `ix.vi`, and `ix.vii`.

The introductory note (`ix.i`), elucidation (`ix.v`), fragments (`ix.viii`), non-`div2` children of Irenaeus `div1` ix, and sibling ANF works in `div1` i–viii are excluded and explicitly accounted. They are not silently merged into *Against Heresies*.

The existing config identifies the 1885 Ante-Nicene Fathers Volume I edition, Alexander Roberts and James Donaldson as editors and translators, and A. Cleveland Coxe as American editor. It labels the work public domain and records that CCEL confirmed parsing is permitted. These statements are retained metadata evidence; human rights review, textual acceptance, and publication authorization remain separate and absent.
